experiment: BRD/BTC rerun with real Kronos-mini weights
status: frozen before any inference; weights and market archive not yet available in this session
inputs: results/2026-11-06/input_manifest.json (official code commit 67b630e, Kronos-mini, Kronos-Tokenizer-2k, BRDBTC-5m-2018-12.zip), SHA256-checked

arms.prescale: each window column divided by its std before the official (std + 1e-5) normalization

scored_bars: every 5-minute bar from 2018-12-22 00:00 to 2018-12-31 23:55 (2880); calibration before 2018-12-28 (1728: fit = first half, validation = second half), test 1152
point_forecast: median over draws of the transformed features; spread = IQR/1.349 over draws
scoring: evidence fusion with the frozen kronos_fusion configuration; variants: kronos mean + spread term, kronos mean only, no kronos

endpoints.E1_scale_collapse: MAE of the mean-of-draws raw OHLC forecast / same-field persistence on calibration bars. Published run: 3.7-5.0. Prescale is judged to fix the collapse if all four ratios < 1.5.
endpoints.E2_skill: stacked Kronos weight per feature and MAE vs best naive on the four features. Kronos is judged to have skill if its weight >= 0.3 on log_return or log_range AND its MAE ratio vs best naive < 1 there.
endpoints.E3_spread: nonnegative pinball coefficient on the kronos:spread term; judged informative if > 0 on at least two features in the prescale arm.
endpoints.E4_detection: descriptive only (one labelled bar): alarms at nominal 1%, alarms on zero-volume bars, pump-bar rank, pump-type injection power at delta 3/6/12, fusion with vs without Kronos.

not_allowed: no change to lookback, sample count, sampling parameters, feature set, partitions or fusion configuration after the first draw is produced; any deviation is listed in the report with before/after numbers
